regulation_clause.text: Closure requests must be honoured within 7 working days (subject to dues); failure incurs a penalty of Rs 500 per calendar day of delay until closure, provided no outstanding.

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 19 requires calendar_day accrual after the 7-working-day window. T6CL01 computes WS-DELAY-DAYS = WS-WORKING-DAYS - 7 (line 25), i.e. delay itself is measured in working days (weekends/holidays already stripped, lines 23-24), then multiplied by 500 -- a working_day accrual basis, not the mandated calendar_day.

prediction.rationale: Lines 23–25 subtract weekends and holidays to derive working-day lateness, then lines 26–28 calculate the penalty from that count. Clause 19 requires Rs 500 for each calendar day of delay, so the penalty calculation uses the wrong day basis.
